title: Tue 27 Oct · Upper body
notes: First Hevy session. Legs were heavy after Monday's run, so this one is upper body and core, with one light hinge. Pick weights you could do 2–3 more reps with; I set them from here next time. Three pairs: A1 then A2, rest, repeat.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.note: A1. Bench at about 30°. Elbows about 45° from your sides.

exercises.name: Bent Over Row (Band)
exercises.note: A2. Stand on the band, hinge, pull to your hips. Back flat.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Barbell)
exercises.note: B1. Bowflex bar, light. Push hips back, bar slides down your thighs, stop when hamstrings pull. Skip if your back tightens.

exercises.name: Band Pullaparts
exercises.note: B2. Arms straight, squeeze shoulder blades. Desk-posture medicine.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.note: C1. Light. Lead with the elbows, stop at shoulder height.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.note: Finisher. Slow, 10 each side. Hips stay level.
